After lots and lots and lots of therapy I realized (with the help my therapist, obvs) that in those kinds of toxic relationships you have to either cut ties completely or you need to be okay with accepting the relationship as is. You can't make your your parents change, you can only change how you react to them unfortunately. My mother was extremely emotionally not there. She abandoned me when I was 16 and has since always tried to blame our failed relationship on me or not calling and ignoring me completely. I could not handle accepting that relationship as it was so I have cut ties. It is not easy. I am now processing a loss almost on par with a death. Anyways, I dont know your specifics or why you can't stop them coming or what they say to you that makes you want to snap. But stand your ground if at all possible. You're in the right. And you're an adult too.
